{{Quote|What're you starin' at?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''I heard what you said about Skywalker. You're right... someone should fix him! I'll pay fifty wupiupi for a saboteur.|Ark Roose and Diva Funquita on Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="PodracingTales">''[[Podracing Tales]]''</ref>|translated=1}}
'''Diva Funquita''' was a [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Ingoda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] alongside [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]] before she ended up being gifted to [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the Hutt. Funquita, a member of the religious singing [[Diva|Divas]], was also able to become the Hutt's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] and chief aide.

On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], shortly before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race, Gardulla tried to get [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the Hutt to place bets on [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], though he bet on podracer [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Gardulla tasked Funquita with finding someone to sabotage the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] of Skywalker, traveling to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to do so. The woman found the podracer [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]], who unknowingly sabotaged the podracer [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. Gardulla and Funquita later viewed the race at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]].

==Biography==
===The Divas===
{{Quote|A gift from Ingoda, in place of credits owed to me. She and Diva Funquita came as a pair, but I made Funquita a present to Gardulla in the hope of smoothing over our lingering rivalry. My first mistake. The second: introducing Shaliqua to Romeo Treblanc, who would move worlds to possess her.|Jabba the Hutt mentions Diva Funquita while talking about Diva Shaliqua|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
The [[Theelin/Legends|Theelins]] Diva Funquita and [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]] were members of the [[Diva|Divas]], a religious order of [[Gender/Legends|female]] Theelin singers.<ref name="Shaliqua">{{DB|character|divashaliqua|Shaliqua, Diva}}</ref><ref name="Databank" /> They were both [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[Ingoda]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] entrepreneur who collected enslaved Theelin beings. When Ingoda became indebted<ref name="Shaliqua" /> over [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> to the Hutt<ref name="Shaliqua" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], the Divas were sold to him, though Jabba only kept Shaliqua. Funquita was given to another Hutt crime lord, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]], as a gift<ref name="Shaliqua" /> to soothe their rivalry<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> and<ref name="Shaliqua" /> the Diva was able to work her way up to become Hutt's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] and chief aide.<ref name="FF112">{{FactFile|112|SLA 1-2|Hutt Slave Girls}}</ref> 

Around [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Jabba mentioned Diva Funquita during a business meeting with the industrialist [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Demask]], who was actually the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis. He reflected on his decision to give Funquita to Gardulla and introducing Shaliqua to [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Romeo Treblanc]] as mistakes.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> 

===A sabotage at the race===
{{Quote|Skywalker should have an accident! Go to Mos Espa and find someone to finish the job!''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Y-yes most exalted one!|Gardulla orders Diva Funquita to sabotage Anakin Skywalkers podracer|<ref name="PodracingTales" />|translated=1}}
[[File:ArkRoosesOffer-PodracingTales.png|thumb|left|350px|Diva Funquita approaches Ark Roose]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[Podracing Tales]]'' is set shortly after and during the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Jabba visited [[Gardulla's palace]] on<ref name="PodracingTales" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to dicuss [[Gambling/Legends|betting]] odds on the upcoming [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Podrace]]. Gardulla attempted to get Jabba to betting on the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|pilot]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], though he was intent on betting on another pilot, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. After Jabba left, Gardulla summoned Funquita and explained her predicament. The Diva asked the Hutt why she believed Gasgano would win, making Gardulla reveal she and "everyone" thought that pilot [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] would win, and that Gasgano was a redirection. The Hutt then ordered the Diva to travel to<ref name="PodracingTales" /> the [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CL" /> [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to find someone to sabotage Skywalker's [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. Funquita traveled away from the palace on a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="PodracingTales" />

In Mos Espa, Funquita came across the [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] podracer [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]] complaining about Skywalker after being accosted by Sebulba. The Theelin played into his dislike of Skywalker and offered him fifty [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]] for him to sabotage his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. Initally, Roose did not understand her, causing Funquita to reexplain herself to the "lunkhead." After he agreed and took the payment, she then left. Roose came across the [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|podracer]] of the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] racer [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]], sabotaging it thinking it was Skywalker's.<ref name="PodracingTales" />

[[File:GardullaFunquita-TPM.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Gardulla and Funquita (left) visited the Mos Espa Grand Arena.]]
During the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Funquita and Gardulla visited<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] and stayed in its royal box area<ref name="CL" /> with Jabba.<ref name="TPM" /> The Diva watched on as Jabba bit off a [[Gorg/Legends|gorg's]] head at spat it out at a [[Gong/Legends|gong]], starting the race. As the racers sped off from the starting area, both Skywalker's and Quadinaros's podracers stalled, though the former was able to start his up. While the racers made their first lap, the engines on Quadinaros's podracer eventually separated and exploded throughout the grand arena. After Skywalker won the race, Funquita walked away from Gardulla and left the royal box.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A sabo-what?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Someone to damage his podracer, you lunkhead!|Ark Roose and Diva Funquita|<ref name="PodracingTales" />|translated=1}}
The Diva found it too much to bear being around a Hutt master, coping by either dancing for the court or addicting herself to [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="FF112" /> She maintained a respectful tone when talking with Gardulla, though the Theelin found herself frustrated at Ark Roose not understanding her offer, calling him a "lunkhead."<ref name="PodracingTales" /> She had brown eyes, light skin with mottled red spots on her left side,<ref name="YJCCG" /> and red hair<ref name="Databank" /> styled in three large trusses above her head.<ref name="YJCCG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Funquita was a member of the Divas,<ref name="Databank" /> members of which had had singing performances compared against theirs by scholars.<ref name="Shaliqua" /> She was also trained dancer and singer.<ref name="Databank" />

==Equipment==
Shortly before<ref name="PodracingTales" /> and during the Boonta Eve Podrace, Funquita wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|dress]], brown arm wrappings, gold earrings, a dark [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with golden and blue jewels,<ref name="TPM" /> and brown sandals.<ref name="PodracingTales" /> The criminal<ref name="Databank" /> departed Gardulla's palace on a red speeder.<ref name="PodracingTales" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Diva Funquita first appeared in the prequel trilogy film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> where the character was portrayed by [[Amanda Lucas]], the daughter of ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]].<ref name="Actor">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref> The film released on [[May 19]], [[1999]],<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> and the character received identification on [[September 15]] of that year<ref name="DK">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0789447010,00.html|text=Star Wars Episode 1: Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref> in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds]].<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Since Funquita shared a first name with the character Diva Shaliqua, fan debate happened over "Diva" being possibly a given name, a [[Species/Legends|species]] name, a title, and more. When writing for Shaliqua through the [[StarWars.com]] "[[What's The Story?]]" feature, author [[Nathan O'Keefe]] made it a title shared between the two characters.<ref name="ValinKenobi">{{Blog|valinkenobi|12|Diva Shaliqua: Behind the scenes}}</ref>
